level_one.title: Psi-Infusion
level_one.description: Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.  Passive: Increase the cast range of Psionic Storm by 33%.

level_four.title: Electric Fence
level_four.description: Force Wall deals 92 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

level_seven.title: Psionic Echo
level_seven.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

level_ten.title: Archon
level_ten.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.  Resonance Beam: Deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the target and splashes 70 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

level_thirteen.title: Feedback
level_thirteen.description: When an enemy Hero is affected by Psionic Storm, Resonance Beam's Slow is increased to 50% and it reduces Physical Armor by 25.

level_one.title: Charged Strikes
level_one.description: Gain 15% Attack Speed. Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 20% bonus damage and bounces to nearby enemy Heroes.

level_four.title: Inner Light
level_four.description: Activate to heal for 25% of your maximum Health over 5 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit with Lightning Fury lower the cooldown of this ability by 10 seconds.

level_seven.title: Seraph's Hymn
level_seven.description: Basic Attacks against your primary enemy Hero grant 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Blinding Light by 2 seconds.  Passive: Increase the passive damage bonus of Blinding Light from 15% to 30%.

level_ten.title: Valkyrie
level_ten.description: Summon a Valkyrie that rushes to Cassia after 0.75 seconds, pulling the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds at the end of her path. The Valkyrie knocks back all other enemy Heroes in her way.

level_thirteen.title: Gloves of Alacrity
level_thirteen.description: Gain 1 Basic Attack range. While Avoidance is fully charged, gain an additional 1 Basic Attack range.

level_one.title: Regeneration Master
level_one.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases your Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 30.  Reward: After gathering 25 Regeneration Globes, you also gain 500 Health.

level_four.title: Shed Exoskeleton
level_four.description: Harden Carapace grants 30% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Chitinous Plating
level_seven.description: While Harden Carapace is active, taking damage from enemy Abilities reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Cocoon
level_ten.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

level_thirteen.title: Burning Beetles
level_thirteen.description: Deal 21 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Beetles deal 6 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

level_one.title: Fetid Touch
level_one.description: Basic Attacks become ranged and Slow enemies by 20% for 1.5 seconds, but deal 35% less damage. This effect can be toggled.  Quest: Hit Heroes with Weighted Pustule.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Weighted Pustule by 5 seconds and remove its Mana cost.

level_four.title: One Good Spread...
level_four.description: After a Healing Pathogen infests 3 targets, restore 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Healing Pathogen by 2 seconds.

level_seven.title: Targeted Excision
level_seven.description: Detonating exactly 1 Weighted Pustule (but any number of Healing Pathogens) with Bio-Kill Switch reduces the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch to 7 seconds and other Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Flailing Swipe
level_ten.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

level_thirteen.title: Virulent Reaction
level_thirteen.description: Detonating a Weighted Pustule on an enemy who is inside of Lurking Arm Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Light of Karabor
level_one.description: Increase Vindication's radius by 15%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Vindication's healing by 40%. If more than one Hero is hit, the bonus is increased to 80%.

level_four.title: Aegis of Light
level_four.description: Upon landing, Avenging Wrath grants other nearby allied Heroes 40 Armor for 5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Righteous Momentum
level_seven.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Yrel is no longer Slowed while Channeling Righteous Hammer, and instead this bonus is quadrupled.

level_ten.title: Sacred Ground
level_ten.description: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

level_thirteen.title: Velen's Chosen
level_thirteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability at maximum charge grants 7.5% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%.

level_one.title: Unrivaled Strength
level_one.description: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 15% and its damage by 75%.

level_four.title: Indomitable
level_four.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Oppressor
level_seven.description: Basic Attacks and Bloodthirst against Heroes reduce the target's Spell Power by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Decimate
level_ten.description: Deal 50 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second.  Stores up to 3 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Bloodcraze
level_thirteen.description: When hitting a Hero, Bloodthirst heals for an additional 15% of Garrosh's maximum Health over 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Seasoned Soldier
level_sixteen.description: Gain 5% maximum Health, increase Groundbreaker's Slow duration by 1 second, and Bloodthirst gains an additional charge.

level_one.title: Quarterback
level_one.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

level_four.title: In the Rhythm
level_four.description: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

level_seven.title: Relentless Soldier
level_seven.description: Being Stunned or Rooted grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

level_ten.title: Drakken Laser Drill
level_ten.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 (+4% per level) damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Spray 'n' Pray
level_thirteen.description: Overkill Slows enemy Movement Speed by 25% and its range is increased by 25%.

level_sixteen.title: Armor Piercing Rounds
level_sixteen.description: Each time Overkill hits an enemy, its damage against them is increased by 15%, stacking up to 60% bonus damage.

level_one.title: Colossal Totem
level_one.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

level_four.title: Earthliving Enchant
level_four.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Grounded Totem
level_seven.description: Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 15% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's cast range by 45%.

level_ten.title: Ancestral Healing
level_ten.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Tidal Waves
level_thirteen.description: Reduces Chain Heal's cooldown by 1 second for each Hero healed, and reduces its Mana cost from 60 to 40.

level_sixteen.title: Earthgrasp Totem
level_sixteen.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 90 (+4% per level) damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

level_one.title: Sentinel Wisp
level_one.description: After remaining in a bush for 5 seconds, Wisp's vision radius is increased by 200% and reveals the surrounding area.

level_four.title: Nature's Culling
level_four.description: Increases Nature's Toxin's damage by 125% to non-Heroes.

level_seven.title: Splintered Spear
level_seven.description: Casting Noxious Blossom grants Lunara 3 stacks of Splintered Spear. When Lunara uses her Basic Attack, it hits an additional enemy for each stack of Splintered Spear, consuming 1 stack for each target. Stores up to 3 stacks.  Splintered Spear deals 90 (+4% per level) damage, and applies Nature's Toxin.

level_ten.title: Leaping Strike
level_ten.description: Leap over an enemy, Slowing them by 80% for 0.35 seconds and dealing 271 (+4% per level) damage.  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Let Them Wither
level_thirteen.description: Increases Crippling Spores' Slow duration by 1 second and causes it to no longer decay.

level_sixteen.title: Unfair Advantage
level_sixteen.description: Nature's Toxin deals 60% more damage to Heroes that are Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

level_one.title: Rocket Boots
level_one.description: Increase the cast range of Xplodium Charge by 30% and its damage by 35%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

level_four.title: Hyperfocus Coils
level_four.description: Heroes hit by Deth Lazor or Xplodium Charge take an additional 2% of their maximum Health in damage. Gazlowe is healed for 150% of the damage dealt.

level_seven.title: Overload
level_seven.description: Deth Lazor can now store up to 2 charges. Each enemy Hero hit by Deth Lazor reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level_ten.title: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
level_ten.description: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

level_thirteen.title: Overcharged Capacitors
level_thirteen.description: Gazlowe gains 5% Spell Power for each active Rock-It! Turret, up to a maximum of 15%. Dealing Basic Attack damage heals Rock-It! Turrets by 8% of their max health.

level_sixteen.title: Ark Reaktor
level_sixteen.description: Reduce the cooldown of Xplodium Charge by 2 seconds. Casting Xplodium Charge creates 3 miniature Rock-It! Turrets that last for 3 seconds.  These Turrets do not drop Scrap or benefit from other Talents.
